analogy.rationale: Chelating agents act on metal-dependent enzymes and have no dedicated transcriptional program in these cell lines; the annotated targets OPRK1 and UGT1A6 are not meaningfully engaged at 10 uM, so responses should be weak and most similar to other classes with little or no specific transcriptional signature.
